purpose: Targeted cleanup of edge halos; preserve six concepts

edits.name: 포털
edits.prompt: Edit the attached logo master. Make only one change: remove all glow, halos, gradients, texture, edge fringes and soft lighting so it becomes a perfectly clean flat two-color graphic. Preserve the exact symbol silhouette, all negative spaces, letter shapes if any, placement, scale and proportions. Fill every part of the symbol with one perfectly uniform solid color #D5E6B4. Fill the entire background and every negative space with uniform opaque #0A0A0A black. There should be a crisp transition directly from solid ink to black, with ordinary antialiasing only. No extra contour, no shadow, no faded green or gray edge. This is a flat logo artwork export, not an illuminated object. Keep the square canvas. Add nothing else.
